faq.q: What is the origin of Aasifah?
faq.a: Aasifah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of aasfa.
Yes — the underlying form عاصفة is Arabic.
Aasifah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
